objective: Screen whether two physically distinct compact ISRJ evidence domains are sufficient before constructing any cross-domain router

domains.envelope_periodicity: envelope autocorrelation lag lattice, peak positions and peak strengths
domains.comb_spectrum: detrended spectrum lag autocorrelation, log-spectrum cepstrum and peak spacing

training.role: optimization identities across all nine paired powers
training.identity_weight: each identity has constant total weight across nine views

thresholds.constraint: each power recall drop relative to B2-RC <= 0.005

primary_slice: 10 dB development ISRJ positives and ISRJ-negative samples containing MFT or VFT
promotion_rule: Only if every gate passes may B6 construct a cross-domain router; otherwise stop before router construction
